notes.title: Dream-Walking Simulator, NIDANA, coming to Steam on July 28, 2025!
notes.content:
PLAYISM is proud to announce that NIDANA, a walking simulator developed by lvl374, is set to launch on July 28, 2025!

She continues to dream.

A first-person dream simulator where you explore fragments of "her" dream.
Immerse yourself in a text-free journey through a surreal geometric realm.
Navigate an abstract dreamscape and uncover its hidden mysteries, all without a single line of text.

[previewyoutube=BVw7lfOoako;full][/previewyoutube]
The release date is right around the corner so please stay tuned and don't forget to add the game to your wishlist!

notes.title: Explore the Corner of a Dream in NIDANA, to be Released in 2025
notes.content:
She continues to dream—this is a first-person dream walking simulator where you explore the corner of a dream.

There is no text whatsoever, only surreal geometrical spaces for you to explore. 

[previewyoutube=KYrQm2P2f34;full][/previewyoutube]
Please look forward to the release in 2025 and add the game to your wishlist.
